verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform for sandboxes, agent hosting, and a model gateway, so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for AI training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-training commitment. The egress allowlists, regions, and access tokens it does document are adjacent security controls, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit here.
